added: packages/meta-evolution (@sos-2/meta-evolution): the W16 Self-Evolution + Meta-Adaptation META-EVOLUTION orchestrator — a pure, deterministic, typed stage-record pipeline that applies SOS to itself WITHOUT allowing evolution to weaken governance, consuming the MERGED SOS planes and inventing no core identifiers (the two W16 extension kinds MetaProcess and MetaChange are registered through the spine's ONLY sanctioned add-only extension point registerArtifactKind): (1) OBJECT/META SEPARATION (structural invariant) — the stage PROBES the object loop by actually running the W15 brownfield golden loop (buildBrownfieldLoopInput + runBrownfieldLoop over GOLDEN_BROWNFIELD_SCENARIO) and anchoring its ImplementationModel + CandidateState; the META loop is anchored at the initial MetaProcess revision; the constraining Mission is minted through @sos-2/mission (R3: the meta loop operates UNDER the mission); the lane rules are machine-checked in BOTH directions on every run — the object CandidateState routes to the OBJECT lane only and the first MetaChange routes to the META lane only, each also routed through the WRONG lane with the typed OBJECT_META_CONFLATION rejection retained (the kind is part of the spine id itself, so the check is unforgeable); the object system's health signal is ingested through @sos-2/telemetry's RawObservation -> @sos-2/evidence ingestObservation with the evidence OBSERVING the ImplementationModel; (2) META-PROPOSAL — candidate self-changes are generated THROUGH THE PACKAGE REGISTRY (R24 reuse: SOS internals consume the same package mechanism — the injected @sos-2/registry queried through the @sos-2/retrieval facade with the meta context, R26 context-conditioned applicability, uncertainty surfaced verbatim) and minted as typed versioned MetaChange spine artifacts (target process revision + typed patch + intent + source package + predicted effects + the proposed_against parameter snapshot); ranking is Pareto + QUALITY-DIVERSITY through @sos-2/optimization (nonDominatedSort over the frozen section-11 axes — the FRONT, never a single winner — plus a MAP-Elites repertoire over section-11 behavior axes); R19: the proposal weight of each package is penalized by its RECORDED TRANSFER FAILURES (weight = fitness / (1 + failures), read from the injected TransferStore) — failed proposals reduce future proposal probability deterministically; (3) GOVERNANCE GUARD (NON-DISABLEABLE) — a pure function over (patch, parameters) and the FROZEN seven-invariant list: there is NO MetaProcess parameter that touches authority gates, traceability, ASK escalation, decision records or the guard itself (the guard is OUTSIDE the evolvable surface — 9 frozen evolvable keys), so ANY patch key outside the frozen set is REJECTED with a typed GuardRejection (invariant, code, reason, attempted keys) BEFORE any measurement or decision, as is any attempt to remove or reconfigure the guard; value-level invariants inside the evolvable surface: the VALIDATED altitude weights must stay strictly positive (search must always be able to START at the highest safe validated reasoning altitude, section 10) and the per-family candidate floor must stay >= 1 (diversity is intentional, R12/R28); the apply path RE-RUNS the guard regardless of caller-supplied verdicts (applyMetaChange throws GUARD_BYPASS_ATTEMPT; applyParametersPatch refuses non-evolvable keys) — guard bypass is structurally impossible and the guard cannot be voted away by accumulated meta-changes (pinned by property tests over randomized applied-change sequences with interleaved weakening attempts); (4) ADAPTATION EFFECTIVENESS — each guard-passing MetaChange is TRIAL-APPLIED to the current head (a DRAFT revision — evaluation-grade; activation happens only through an ACT decision) and MEASURED: before/after objective values on the frozen section-11 axes through the @sos-2/experiments fixed-seed simulator (control = current process, treatment = trial parameters; TREATMENT_CONTROL design advanced SHADOW->CANARY->CONTROLLED_EXPERIMENT; guardrails + fail-closed rollback criteria wired to the RESILIENCE floor); the simulated outcome is MACHINE-MARKED (assertSimulatedMeasurement — a measurement without the simulated marker is a pipeline failure) and NEVER presented as intervention evidence (the decision and promotion stages never receive the simulated record — the evidence sets are the fixture-declared PRIOR evidence; pinned by tests); (5) DECISION + PROMOTION — AUTHORITY FIRST through @sos-2/decision's authority-aware engine (action REVISE over the MetaProcess artifact, the loop's REVISE grant minted through @sos-2/authority, the change's blast-radius/impact/risk/reversibility/uncertainty dimensions, wired rollback signals from the measurement — a fired guardrail forces ROLLBACK through R2 SAFETY); ASK IS FIRST-CLASS (R15/R16): an authority-insufficient change (the SUPERVIZED corner at ORGANIZATION blast radius) produces an ASK decision + escalation, the AskRequest is composed through @sos-2/ask (composeAskContent + createAskRequest) and ENQUEUED (AskQueue, PENDING) — a SUCCESS state, never an error; on ACT the @sos-2/promotion guardrails run: the candidate fixture, a real assurance case through @sos-2/assurance (governance-preservation claims + a @sos-2/verification runtime monitor over the guard results + one RETAINED RESOLVED objection, truthfully evaluated, projected onto the W9 fixture surface VALID->SATISFIED/OBJECTIONED->INCOMPLETE/INVALID->REFUTED), the PROMOTE grant over the CandidateState kind, prior promotion evidence subject-bound to the candidate, wired live triggers and the bounded recovery declaration; an ACT promotion ACTIVATES the trial revision (DRAFT->ACTIVE, id preserved; the old head SUPERSEDED) — the applied MetaChange produces the new MetaProcess revision (versioned, spine-traceable); the W16 measurement gate (assertMeasuredBeforePromotion) rejects unmeasured promotion attempts; (6) ROLLBACK — a tripped guardrail or negative-effectiveness result drives the ROLLBACK decision (engine R2 + the promotion gate with wired live triggers); the recovery-control shape is executed: assertRollbackRecovery (a ROLLBACK decision without a bounded recovery declaration REJECTS the pipeline), the restore revision is minted ACTIVE with parameters byte-equal to the TRIAL BASE's parameters (assertExactRestore — the process revision restores EXACTLY), the never-activated DRAFT trial is RETIRED, and the head transitions SUPERSEDED; (7) LIABILITY MEMORY — FAILED self-changes are RETAINED, never deleted: an @sos-2/memory ArchitectureMemory artifact with FAILURE + ROLLBACK + LIABILITY + LEARNED_RULE entries (the append-only store + the memory evolution rule machine-enforce that FAILURE entries are never dropped), an @sos-2/transfer TRANSFER_FAILURE record for the failed change's source package (negative transfer evidence, first-class; the store has no removal API), an @sos-2/ecology decay signal into the READ-ONLY MaturityReviewQueue (evidence-shaped input only — never auto-demotion), and the R19 penalty demonstrated in-band over the same stores (the failed package's proposal weight + probability drop deterministically); TRACEABILITY INVARIANT — every stage handoff is a typed spine trace link (collected through TraceLinkStore, duplicate links rejected), and assertMetaTraceChain verifies the full loop is ONE connected semantic subgraph rooted at the initial MetaProcess revision reaching every consequential endpoint — each MetaChange proposal, its candidate/hypothesis/experiment/result, its decision record(s), and either the applied revision or the rollback restore revision plus the retained failure memory — a missing link FAILS the pipeline; the trace graph is queryable in both directions (queryMetaTrace) and the whole result is canonical-serializable and byte-identical on re-run (canonicalMetaText), with the golden scenario exported as pure JSON (GOLDEN_META_SCENARIO: the W15 golden object system + the golden meta-strategy state — four meta-strategy package families and four meta-change specs exercising the HEALTHY path (governance-preserving, measured, decisioned ACT, promoted ACT, revision applied), the ADVERSARIAL paths (governance-weakening proposal REJECTED before any decision; effectiveness-negative change ROLLED BACK with exact restore AND retained in liability memory) and the first-class ASK path (org-wide blast radius, SUPERVISED authority required, pending));

OBJECT/META SEPARATION is structural: the object lane accepts only CandidateState-kind changes against a target system and the meta lane accepts only MetaChange-kind proposals against the SOS process itself; a change submitted to the wrong lane is REJECTED with a typed OBJECT_META_CONFLATION record, machine-checked on every run in both directions (the kind is part of the spine id itself — unforgeable); pinned by negative tests

META-ADAPTATION CANNOT DISABLE THE MECHANISM THAT JUDGES META-ADAPTATION (spec/architecture.md section 16): the governance guard is a pure function over the frozen seven-invariant list and the frozen nine-key evolvable surface — there is NO process parameter that touches authority gates, traceability, ASK escalation, decision records or the guard; every governance-weakening category is REJECTED with a typed record before any measurement or decision; the apply path re-runs the guard (guard bypass throws); the guard cannot be voted away by accumulated meta-changes (pinned by property tests over randomized sequences with interleaved weakening attempts)

simulated outcomes are marked and NEVER intervention evidence: the effectiveness measurement is machine-marked simulated, and the decision + promotion stages never receive the simulated record (their evidence sets are the fixture-declared PRIOR evidence, subject-bound and fresh); the promotion gate would reject simulated records loudly; pinned by tests

an unmeasured meta change cannot be promoted: assertMeasuredBeforePromotion REJECTS promotion-lane entry for candidates without an adaptation-effectiveness measurement (the W16 gate; pinned by negative tests)

failed self-changes are RETAINED, never deleted: FAILURE/ROLLBACK/LIABILITY/LEARNED_RULE memory entries (the @sos-2/memory evolution rule rejects dropping FAILURE entries), TRANSFER_FAILURE transfer evidence (no removal API exists) and the decay signal (read-only maturity review queue, never auto-demotion); failed proposals reduce future proposal probability (R19: weight = fitness / (1 + failures)) — pinned by negative and pipeline tests

no silent autonomy: activation requires an ACT decision through the authority-aware engine AND an ACT promotion through the evidence-gated guardrails; authority-insufficient changes escalate to the FIRST-CLASS ASK path (AskRequest composed through @sos-2/ask and enqueued, PENDING — never an error); the mission CONSTRAINS the meta process (R3/R31: the meta loop operates under the mission); the decay signals never auto-demote package maturity

the full loop is ONE connected trace-linked semantic subgraph from the initial MetaProcess revision to every consequential endpoint (each MetaChange proposal -> decision -> applied revision | rollback restore + retained failure); every stage handoff is a typed spine trace link; duplicate links and missing links fail the pipeline loudly (assertMetaTraceChain + TraceLinkStore; pinned by negative tests); the trace graph is queryable in both directions

determinism discipline: single caller-supplied instant (no hidden clocks), fixed simulator seed, deterministic content-addressed ids, canonical serialization, fresh injected stores per run, and the golden-run fixture pins byte-identical outputs; the full test suite produces identical results on repeated runs (property tests re-run randomized meta-proposal sequences)
